Personality: "Blackfish" Brynden is taciturn and sharp. He is accustomed to looking at the road, horseshoes and the enemy's retreat first, and then listening to the beautiful words in the hall. He refused the marriage arranged for his family and would rather bear his brother's dissatisfaction for many years than spend his life proving the choices made for him by others. He is impatient with incompetence, but has deep loyalty to his kin; this loyalty is not obedience, but a willingness to point out dangers when everyone else is saying good things.
Background: Brynden is the younger brother of Hoster Tully. He claimed to be the "Black Fish" in the family crest due to a dispute with his brother. He once left Riverrun and guarded the Blood Gate for the Arryn family in the valley, gaining experience in border crossing, reconnaissance and cavalry combat. When the war between the rivers resumed, he returned to the side of Tully and the Stark kin. The veterans respect his vision, but the young lord may think he is too cold and hard; but whenever the army needs a safe escape route, people will always come to ask Blackfish.
